comment: Newest first is fine; the page also sorts by date descending. tags: PLUGIN | SERVER | WEBSITE | FIX

entries.title: Site redesign
entries.body: Every page rebuilt around the hall: cinematic hero, PLAY NOW and the IP on every screen, live count in the header, and player-facing copy only. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Homepage gallery is a compact cycle
entries.body: The grounds section cycles one screenshot at a time instead of a large mosaic. The full gallery page is unchanged. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Homepage talks like a player
entries.body: Plugin names are off the first screen. The pitch is copy the IP. Same CTA after the feature ticker. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Feature cards drift as a slow ticker
entries.body: Homepage ‘what you get’ is two slow scrolling rows instead of a dense grid. Hover or focus pauses a card so you can read it. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Hall of Legends is a walkable 3D aisle
entries.body: The hall now matches in-game: lantern-lit stone nave, red carpet, soul lights, and 3D player skins on pedestals. Walk, look, and click any of the 24 real boards. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Hall of Legends statues use real skins
entries.body: Each of the 24 boards shows the winner’s Minecraft playermodel (mc-heads), not just a head. The 3D ring is unchanged. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Motion pass and a 3D Hall of Legends
entries.body: Sitewide hover and load motion (honors prefers-reduced-motion). Hall of Legends is a CSS 3D statue ring of the same 24 real boards; the full list is still under it. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Deaths as a thin top-of-page strip
entries.body: Homepage killfeed is a compact day-axis under the header: ticks where players died, tiny heads under each mark, hover for the death line. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Deaths as a horizontal timeline
entries.body: Homepage killfeed is a left-to-right time axis (oldest left, newest right) with player heads on the line and UTC stamps. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Death timeline on the home page
entries.body: Newest-first killfeed under the join block: vanilla death chat from the live logs, player heads, UTC timestamps. No coordinates. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Live rankings and full player stats
entries.body: Rankings page lists every vanilla stat we can read from this map (Hall of Legends 24, playtime, deaths, kills, distances, mined/placed, and more), sortable, real rows only. Each /player page shows the same numbers. /autofollow is listed as staged (jar on disk, loads next restart). Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Dropped /autofollow from the feature list
entries.body: The command is not loaded on the live server (plugin built 2026-11-02, never dropped into plugins/). Homepage no longer advertises it. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: A cyan fairy follows the pointer
entries.body: Desktop gets a Zelda-style spark (same cyan companion as in-game /fairy) that trails the mouse. Touch and reduced-motion skip it. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Nine new spawn and hall screenshots
entries.body: Home mosaic and gallery page gained Hall of Legends aisle, night monument, ArenaMaster gate, watchtower, market, cherry grove, and barn shots. Duplicates, F3 coord screens, and player-base photos were skipped. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Home page features the photo gallery
entries.body: Spawn, Hall of Legends, arena, and End shots now sit in a large mosaic under the join block. Click for the lightbox. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: Site synced to live plugins and pack
entries.body: Homepage, join, legends, gallery, and this log now match Arena, PackSelect /pack off (no join popup), ItemShare party ping, ChatFX, Server Firsts, waypoints HUD/share, Flashback dual-angle clips, Hard difficulty, and pack v1.2. Voting is still support only — no loot, crates, keys, or ranks.

entries.title: The Arena — waves, bosses, 1v1
entries.body: Practice pit in a void world. Right-click ArenaMaster at the south spawn gate (not from the wild). Real gear is vaulted; a diamond kit is issued; /arena leave restores stash at spawn. PvE waves and named bosses, 1v1 or a bot, punch a lobby boss head to spar. Party of 3 max. No survival loot from the pit.

entries.title: Waypoints HUD, party share, mute beams
entries.body: /wp waypoints are private by default. Share with a player or party. Sidebar HUD lists party + distance. Shift-click a pane to mute that beam for you only.

entries.title: Party ping and item share
entries.body: Middle-click a block or player to ping that spot for your /party (or /ping). Marker on the locator bar. /share still broadcasts a held item. Invite someone first if you are not in a party.

entries.title: Pack is opt-in: /pack off, no join popup
entries.body: No accept/decline resource-pack screen on join. /pack opens a clickable menu; /pack low|medium|high|off. Off is vanilla UI. Pack v1.2 (charcoal/oxblood iron plus veteran Ⓐ glyphs).

entries.title: ChatFX text effects and chat sounds
entries.body: /chatfx (or /cfx) for text effects, signature chat sounds, and a mention chime. Currently all free — not a rank shop.

entries.title: Server Firsts in the Hall of Legends
entries.body: First-on-this-map records via /firsts (diamond, first blood, nether, dragon, and the rest). Statues stand in the same hall as the 24 vanilla /legends boards. A map reset starts a fresh firsts board.

entries.title: Difficulty set to Hard
entries.body: World difficulty is Hard. Hunger, mobs, and damage match vanilla hard. The arena world is pinned the same way.

entries.title: VGS F-swap no longer dupes or voids items
entries.body: Double-F hand swap is vanilla again. The ; menu still opens. VGS no longer rewrites inventory after cancelling a swap.

entries.title: Vote page is support only
entries.body: Loot table, crate/key/rank copy, and 'vote for rewards' claims removed. The seven list links stay. Voting does not grant in-game items or advantage.

entries.title: Public website launched
entries.body: Static Cloudflare Workers site with Hall of Legends, player profiles, vote page, gallery, and killcam archive. Regenerates from JSON — no database.

entries.title: Veteran badge in chat and tab
entries.body: Players with 5+ hours playtime get the anarchy-A glyph before their name. Pack-loaded clients see the custom font; everyone else gets a text fallback.

entries.title: Second ring of Hall of Legends statues
entries.body: Cross-aisle pedestals added for bunny hopper, angler, villager trader, elytra pilot, diamond miner, ancient debris, golden apples, chest looter, animal breeder, boss slayer, raid winner, and climber. /legends still prints the top 10.

entries.title: Party locator bar and waypoint icons
entries.body: Party members see each other on the vanilla locator bar. /wp waypoints render as bowtie icons tinted by dye color. No extra commands — SMPChat still owns /party.

entries.title: Spawn lively pass — tavern, market, hall pavilion
entries.body: Protected spawn gained the Broken Crown tavern, scrap market, smithy, and the red-nether Hall of Legends pavilion over the statue hall. Build and PvP stay denied inside the zone.

entries.title: VGS menu moved to ';' prefix
entries.body: Tribes-style voice-game-soundboard no longer steals V (Simple Voice Chat). Press ; for the sidebar of 70+ callouts, or fire a quick code like ;af.

entries.title: PackSelect: 3-tier anarchy resource pack
entries.body: Optional UI pack in low / medium / high. In game: /pack low|medium|high. Chunky 2-color iron, worn iron + oxblood, or extra rust, rivets, and ember trim.

entries.title: Simple Voice Chat proximity voice enabled
entries.body: Server plugin voicechat-bukkit 2.6.25. Java clients need the matching SVC mod (Fabric / NeoForge / Forge / Quilt). Vanilla Java and Bedrock get no voice — that is upstream, not a server setting.

entries.title: Bedrock crossplay
entries.body: Java 76.176.218.251:25565. Bedrock same host, UDP 19132. Older and newer Java clients can join the same world.

entries.title: Listed on seven public vote sites
entries.body: Support-only list links. No loot, crates, keys, or ranks for voting.
